subject: Recap + MPA: Novasys pilot goals, owners, and exec readiness
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@novasys.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + MPA: Novasys pilot goals, owners, and exec readiness

Hi Lena — thanks again for a productive 45m today. Quick recap from my side and a first draft Mutual Action Plan (MPA) so we have alignment on owners, milestones, and timing. Please let me know if anything below needs adjusting.

High-level pain & goals you reiterated
- Latency spikes and unpredictable token cost on inference for high-concurrency search re-ranking (current infra limits throughput at 200 qps).
- Need deterministic SLA for production scoring (p95 under 120ms) for customer-facing features.
- Reduce per-inference cost by ~40% vs current provider while maintaining answer quality.

Goals for the pilot
1) Validate latency and throughput at 1k qps with 50-200 token responses.
2) Demonstrate cost delta across batching/quantization profiles on a representative workload.
3) Prove end-to-end integration with your auth layer and data governance controls (VPC + KMS).

Draft MPA (owners & dates)
- Week 0 (Oct 5): Exec alignment + kickoff — Marcus Lin (Redwood) / Lena Ortiz (Novasys) — confirm success criteria + contacts (schedule link: https://cal.com/redwood/demo/novasys-exec-20261005).
- Week 1 (Oct 6–12): Env prep — Jasmine Liu (Redwood SE) / Novasys infra lead — provide SOC2 summary and SSO checklist; test access to staging VPC.
- Week 2 (Oct 13–19): Pilot run 1 — Redwood runs baseline & optimized configs; share token-level cost report.
- Week 3 (Oct 20–26): Integration + latency tuning — joint tuning sessions; confirm p95 SLO gating.
- Week 4 (Oct 27–31): Exec review & decision — Novasys procurement + product sponsor sign-off; confirm next-phase commitment or PO.

Open items / asks from Novasys
- Procurement contact for PO timeline (cc your procurement alias if helpful).
- Any non-disclosure addenda that need to be in place before we exchange full logs.
- Representative dataset slice for the pilot (10k queries).

Attachments: I’ve attached our SOC2 summary and a short SSO integration checklist for your infra team.

Next steps (from Redwood)
- I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the Oct 5 kickoff and loop in Jasmine for the environment prep.
- Jasmine will publish a short runbook and the stub data schema by Oct 2.

If this looks right, can you confirm your procurement contact and whether Oct 5 works for the exec kickoff?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0136

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@novasys.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, procurement@novasys.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MPA: Novasys pilot goals, owners, and exec readiness

Marcus — thank you for the clear summary and timeline. This matches our internal readouts. A few clarifications:

- Procurement contact: procurement@novasys.ai (they're on copy).
- Our infra lead (for VPC/KMS access): Ethan Chu <ethan.chu@novasys.ai> — I’ll add him to the kickoff invite and share a small dataset slice by Oct 1.
- We will need the SOC2 report and SSO checklist in place before you run token-level logs in our staging environment.

I attached a draft SOW the legal team prefers to use as a starting point (Novasys-SOW-draft.docx). We’re not asking for major vendor changes but we do want standard liability and data handling language clarified.

Oct 5 for an exec kickoff works for our director and product sponsor; please send calendar times.

Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, Novasys.ai
lena@novasys.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@novasys.ai>, procurement@novasys.ai
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MPA: Novasys pilot goals, owners, and exec readiness

Thanks, Lena — appreciate the fast turnaround and for adding procurement.

Per your ask, I’ve attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and sso-integration-checklist.xlsx. The SOC2 summary is a high-level artifact; we can coordinate an NDA if you need the full report. The SSO checklist includes SAML attributes and expected metadata exchange steps for your infra team.

Updated asks from our side:
- Please confirm Ethan Chu is available for a short VPC access window (we only need staging credentials for 48 hours to run the initial perf sweep).
- Confirm target PO decision window (you mentioned end of October in the call) so we can prioritize reserved capacity sizing.

I also updated the MPA milestone list to include the procurement review week and a short legal touchpoint. See inline below: 

- Week 0 (Oct 5): Exec kickoff — Marcus / Lena — confirm success criteria.
- Week 1 (Oct 6–12): Env prep — Jasmine / Ethan Chu (Novasys infra).
- Week 2 (Oct 13–19): Perf sweep & cost report — Redwood delivers cost/latency comparison.
- Week 3 (Oct 20–26): Joint tuning; procurement review starts.
- Week 4 (Oct 27–31): Legal & procurement finalize SOW; decision/PO expected by Oct 31.

Attaching files referenced above. Let me know when procurement would like a short call to walk the SOW.

—Marcus
(attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, sso-integration-checklist.xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@novasys.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, procurement@novasys.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MPA: Novasys pilot goals, owners, and exec readiness

Looping in quickly from an SE/ops perspective — thanks Marcus and Lena. A couple operational notes and my proposed immediate owners: 

Operational checklist (short):
- Jasmine will publish the runbook and expected dataset schema by Oct 2 (Jasmine, pls confirm when done).
- Novasys to provide a staging user with scoped VPC access for the 48h perf sweep (Ethan).
- I’ll provision a temporary GPU pool for the pilot window and coordinate a 90-min tuning session on Oct 15.

Proposed owners (single-point contacts)
- Exec sponsor (business): Lena Ortiz (Novasys)
- Product owner (Novasys): Ethan Chu
- Redwood SE lead: Jasmine Liu
- Redwood AM: Marcus Lin
- Procurement & legal touchpoint: procurement@novasys.ai

Next steps:
1) Marcus — can you drop the Oct 5 kickoff times (morning PT preferred) and include Ethan?
2) Lena / procurement — confirm whether the SOW draft needs redlines before the legal call or whether we should review together on the procurement call.
3) Jasmine — confirm runbook publish ETA.

If we get these triaged this week we can stay on the proposed October decision window. Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
(attachments referenced earlier)
